notes: Item 19 is present and discloses extensive financial performance data for Teriyaki Madness (M.H. Franchise Company Inc., 2026 FDD). Three categories of data are included: (1) Gross Sales Table (3 years: 2023–2025) for franchisees meeting conditions; (2) Annual Gross Sales by Quartile tables (Quartiles 1–4, 3 years each); (3) Individual shop P&L statements for the 140-shop 2025 Reporting Group, organized by tenure cohort (8+ years: Shops A–S; 6–8 years: Shops T–AI; 4–6 years: Shops AJ–AR; additional shops in 2–4 year and 1–2 year cohorts shown in summary tables). Individual shop P&L records are extracted for shops A through AR from the images; the summary average/median income statement tables (pages 80–81, PDF pages 72–73) contain aggregated cohort averages and medians but their numeric values are in image-only tables not captured in the text extraction layer — those records are flagged with null values. The quartile tables use POS data (not necessarily P&L-sourced) while the individual P&L and gross sales tables use franchisee-reported P&L data. Note: the text extraction for pages 69–79 (PDF pages 61–71) was largely blank, so individual shop data was sourced from the images provided. Some individual shop detail pages (2–4 years and 1–2 years cohorts) were not visible in provided images and could not be extracted.
